name: Bounded Continuation Persistence Scope Boundary Consistency

consistency_rules.rule: If C_A > B_local(alpha), the case must be excluded from restricted-domain persistence.
If T_access <= severance_threshold, topology accessibility failure must block persistence scope.
If R_divergence > epsilon_crit, reconstruction ambiguity must block unique persistence claims.
If I_continuity fragments into non-equivalent branches, identity persistence must remain ambiguous.
If oscillatory continuation fails bounded stabilization criteria, active continuation must not count as persistence.
If cross-mechanism divergence exceeds tolerance, mechanism-independent persistence must not be claimed.
